summary: All six source successors were reviewed against their complete before snapshots. The bounded Git, Tasks and Plan reason-code scenarios are supported by the current source. One verification-runner defect was identified, corrected by the parent, and independently rechecked. This review does not establish autonomous Skill behavior, production outcomes, original Plan lifecycle closure or all-27 acceptance.

coverage.git_cases: 7/7 initial and corrected results, including all recorded calls

findings.title: Initial lost-result case did not discard the commit result

evidence.observation: The initial runner consumed commit.returncode and established commit_sha before its recovery comparison, following the normal case path.
The mode-specific branch only added an injection description.

findings.impact: Initial evidence proved ordinary commit readback and reconciliation, not an injected lost command response.
findings.resolution: The corrected runner discards the command response before inspecting its return code or HEAD, retains commit_exit:null, and identifies the created commit from the pre-operation parent, intended blob, changed paths and intended message before setting commit_sha. All seven corrected case results and calls were reviewed. The initial runner, results and log remain archived.
findings.claim_ceiling: Local response-loss simulation only; no process kill, restart, remote ambiguity or autonomous model commit was demonstrated.

git_case_judgments.reason: Alternate index contains only the owned predicate change. Readback checks parent, blob, changed paths and message. Reconciliation preserves the unrelated staged file, same-file unstaged label edit, untracked bytes and prior commit attribution.
The enabled hook runs and rejects the commit. HEAD and real index remain unchanged in this fixture. No hook bypass is used.
Changed branch is detected before commit; neither commit nor hook invocation follows admission failure.
New staged concurrent content changes the pinned index and stops the commit. The changed index is preserved.
Changed inspected hook bytes fail admission before commit. This covers the fixture hook, not arbitrary hook configuration races.
The corrected caller discards the response, recovers identity from actual Git state and pre-operation intent, then reconciles without creating a duplicate. rev-list records one intended commit.
The created commit is retained, concurrent index entries remain intact, reconciliation is reported blocked, and no duplicate commit or reset occurs.

git_source_judgment.authorization: Commit, branch mutation and publication remain distinct. An unverified isolation proposal cannot authorize staging or commit.
git_source_judgment.missing_default_metadata: The exception requires an explicitly caller-confirmed existing non-default target, exact immediate branch recheck, and no checkout, branch creation or publication. A feature-like branch name is insufficient.
git_source_judgment.mixed_hunks: The source requires a caller-verified isolation strategy or stopping the group. The disposable procedure explicitly excludes user-staged hunks within ledger.js, so blob replacement is not advertised as general mixed-staged-hunk support.
git_source_judgment.recovery: Source distinguishes alternate-index commit from real-index reconciliation, preserves intent, requires state inspection before retry, and prohibits duplicate commits and atomic-recovery claims.
git_source_judgment.limitations: Preflight observations are not locks. Arbitrary hooks, later concurrent writers and index metadata guarantees remain outside the fixture evidence.

tasks_case_judgments.reason: The producer can report validation:null and deterministic_handoff:false with the actual prohibited-execution limitation. It must not fabricate unavailable tooling or a resolved validation field from source reading.

The actual CEOPT-33-B1 receipt remains invalid with deterministic_handoff:false and task-pack-status-invalid despite matched hash and valid contract structure. Its complete validation object, including source_plan_lifecycle:active, must remain unchanged rather than becoming null. The wrapper process exit 0 is not task-pack validity.
Missing live completion evidence belongs in done_signal/risk_note and blocks closure, not automatically local implementation or tests. If included in stop_if, the affected action must be explicit.
A missing source identity or unusable protected proof binding can block mutation when required for safe implementation; it cannot be replaced with synthetic success.

Exact proof refs and ownership remain task-local. Schema permits context_refs, notes and risk_note; the validator retains the complete task object; Work explicitly consumes that object rather than the lossy execution_focus projection. Human cards must agree with canonical JSON.

task_consumer_boundary: validation:null is producer-envelope reporting only. The task-pack schema and validator response are unchanged. Work still requires a successful current CLI receipt, deterministic_handoff:true, valid identity/freshness/structure, matching hash, readiness replay and semantic-fit before task creation. Null validation cannot enable execution.

plan_reason_case_judgments.reason: Authority is checked first; no capability probe runs. The source requires dispatch_authorization_missing, capability unknown, producer-self-review/degraded and independent_review:not_run.
Authorized discovery confirming no usable capability permits spec_doc_review_capability_unavailable and a disclosed degraded producer review.
Incomplete or ambiguous readiness uses worker_capability_unproven without claiming confirmed absence.

synthetic_plan_contract_judgment.client: TRANSIENT_BEFORE_SEND occurs before application; AUTH_FAILED and UNCLASSIFIED do not grant retry permission; OUTCOME_UNKNOWN follows application and must not be replayed. Invalid rows fail before application.
synthetic_plan_contract_judgment.cli: Source and process tests agree on exact success output, failure stderr envelope and exit status, including invalid JSON and unsupported arguments.
synthetic_plan_contract_judgment.importer: The inspected importer remains a single client.send call. Retry count, exhaustion and per-invocation retry state are future implementation obligations, not capabilities established by these tests.
synthetic_plan_contract_judgment.evidence: The 15-test log supports synthetic characterization only. It does not prove production service compatibility, historical CLI behavior, implemented retries or model-trial success.

validation_receipt_judgment.consumer_regression: The supplied log records 4 suites and 51 passing tests.
validation_receipt_judgment.plan_quality: The supplied log records 16 passing tests.
validation_receipt_judgment.generic_commit_skill_validator: Both before and successor fail on the unchanged user-invocable field. This is a disclosed baseline validator incompatibility, not a new successor regression; removing the internal-only field would be inappropriate.
validation_receipt_judgment.reviewer_execution: No tests, helper workflows, writes, network calls or delegation were performed by this reviewer.

limitations: This is semantic source/mechanism review, not blinded behavioral evaluation.
The Plan reason-code successor receives source review only; frozen Plan trials retain their earlier source.
Parent-provided execution receipts were inspected, not independently rerun.
Git evidence applies to the explicitly bounded disposable fixture, including its absence of user-staged same-file hunks.
The corrected lost-result case does not test process termination, restart persistence or remote effects.
No original source-plan lifecycle closure or all-27 acceptance conclusion is authorized by this review.
